sideB.text:
JOHANNESBURG
26°12'15"S 28°2'50"E

Inland map art with a bullseye sticker circle in the center. No anchor. No search box.

The bottom edge repeats JOHANNESBURG and the coordinates upside down.

rules: Second blue Player card for Johannesburg. Not a port. No search.
The bullseye in the map art is the player-card upgrade slot.
notes: Same coordinates as the search card: 26°12'15"S 28°2'50"E.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
